_comment: Config-as-code for the backend API service. Point the service's 'Config as
code' path at backend/railway.json and leave its root directory at the
repository root: backend/Dockerfile copies data/ and evals/, so the build
context has to be the repo root, not backend/.
The worker services use the SAME image and override only the start command;
see worker.railway.json and docs/deployment.md. No start command is set here
because the image's CMD already binds $PORT.
